name: Honda CM400 / CM450
engine: 395 or 447 cc air-cooled parallel twin, two carbs
intro: Honda's custom twins of the early 80s. Simple engines, two carbs, and a Hondamatic on the A models.

K: The A models use a two-speed Hondamatic with its own fluid. Check the level and condition before you ride it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
